$comment: AgentFleet regression policy (AF-CI-001d, docs/agentfleet/CI.md). excludedFiles: upstream test files not run in the fork, each with its reason and the decision that approved it; they are also listed in docs/agentfleet/README.md. allowedSkips: skipped or todo tests accepted as exceptions, each with its family, reason and approving decision, matched by file and exact full name, or by file and full-name prefix with the exact count expected. In a lot that runs the file, an exception that does not match exactly fails the lot. Any other skipped, todo or failed test fails the lot.
